gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Laptop GPU, 6144 MiB
ground_truth: CoppeliaSim /Base pose every control step (used for scoring only)

metric_definitions.frame: 2D world frame of the CoppeliaSim scene (x, y in m, yaw in rad, CCW); SLAM initialised at the GT start pose, no trajectory alignment
metric_definitions.ate: per-step Euclidean position error |p_est - p_gt| over every control step; RMSE/mean/median/max
metric_definitions.final_drift_pct: final position error / GT path length * 100
metric_definitions.rpe: distance-based relative pose error over 1.0 m GT segments, relative motion in the start body frame; trans RMSE (m), mean trans error as % of segment, rot RMSE (deg/m)
metric_definitions.icp_acceptance: share of SLAM updates whose scan match passed the acceptance gates (else odometry-only)
metric_definitions.relocalized: tracking-loss episode followed by an accepted loop closure within 30 s
metric_definitions.wall_accuracy/completion: mean distance SLAM->reference occupied cells / reference->SLAM (m)
metric_definitions.precision/recall/f1: occupied-cell agreement with reference grid within tolerance_m
metric_definitions.free_space_iou: IoU of free cells between SLAM grid and reference grid
metric_definitions.latency: wall-clock time of each agent.step() call (ms), p50/p95/max over all calls
